panels.description: This metric shows the percentage of requests that completed successfully in the selected period. It is the primary reliability indicator and should be read alongside request volume for context.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)

panels.description: This metric shows the percentage of requests that completed successfully in the selected period. It is the primary reliability indicator and should be read alongside request volume for context.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) AS time_sec,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS stability_pct
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY s.window_start
ORDER BY s.window_start

targets.rawSql:

  s.window_start AS time,
  SUM(s.total_requests) AS request_count
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)

panels.title: Stability Status Distribution

panels.description: This metric shows the average response-time level for requests in the selected period. It helps you evaluate overall speed health and identify when performance is drifting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.window_start AS time,
  ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS avg_response_time
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND s.avg_response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location)
GROUP BY s.window_start
ORDER BY s.window_start

panels.title: Proxies Without Version (Table)

panels.description: This metric shows the average response-time level for requests in the selected period. It helps you evaluate overall speed health and identify when performance is drifting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.name,
  p.location,
  COALESCE(p.version, '-')                                                                    AS version,
  SUM(s.total_requests)                                                                        AS total_requests,
  SUM(s.success_count)                                                                         AS success_count,
  ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2)                  AS success_rate_pct,
  SUM(s.failure_count)                                                                         AS failure_count,
  ROUND(SUM(s.failure_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2)                  AS failure_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS avg_response_ms,
  p.stability_status,
  p.rotation_status
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start)
  AND p.location IN ($location)
  AND p.active = true
GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location, p.version, p.stability_status, p.rotation_status
ORDER BY success_rate_pct ASC, total_requests DESC
